blurb: This check verifies that the autoconf6 daemon is not started at boot on a server where IPv6 is not utilized. An enabled autoconf6 starts the IPv6 address-autoconfiguration daemon, an unneeded network-facing service on a non-IPv6 server that an auditor will flag; the required state is that no uncommented "start /usr/sbin/autoconf6" line appears in /etc/rc.tcpip.
